build_video_transformer: build a SpaceTimeTransformer model with configurable num_frames, embed_dim, and depth for video understanding
create_video_patch_embed: create a VideoPatchEmbed module to convert video frames into patch embeddings using 2D convolution
run_var_attention: run the VarAttention module with optional text cross-attention for image-to-text multimodal attention
test_spacetime_block: test the SpaceTimeBlock forward pass with separate space and time attention using einops rearrangements
refactor_mlp: refactor the Mlp feed-forward network to support custom activation layers and configurable hidden dimensions
